Red Envelopes & Gifts

Can digital products work here?

Yes. Checklists, ceremony scripts, bilingual explanation cards, and printable planning sheets are practical digital products.

DirectoryWhy digital worksWhere to place them

Why digital works

Wedding planning has repeatable documents: checklists, scripts, bilingual cards, sequence sheets, and family discussion templates. These can become low-risk digital products.

Where to place them

Digital products can live near the planning tool, tea ceremony guide, FAQ details, and resource center so readers find them at decision points.
